messages:
maya: Hey folks — launching the Maintainers Springboard toolkit (v0.1) today. It's a curated set of scripts, templates, and onboarding docs to help new maintainers get started. GitHub: https://github.com/redwood-inference/maintainers-springboard

maya: TL;DR — includes `issue-template`, `contrib-guides`, a checklist for releases, and a tiny onboarding CLI.

samir: Love this. Is the CLI packaged? how do we install?

julia: Install snippet:
```
pip install redwood-maintainer-springboard==0.1.0
rwsb init --org redwood-inference
```

oliver: CI passed on staging, see releasenotes-bot: "release draft created"

releasenotes-bot: release draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/maintainers-springboard/releases/tag/v0.1.0

chris: Can we get a short blurb for community newsletter? @devrel, you on this?

devrel-bot: @devrel assigned. ETA: tomorrow morning

devrel: Yep, I can draft. Would be helpful to get 3 bullet highlights + example use-case.

maya: 3 bullets: 1) fast onboarding with templates, 2) release checklist reduces regressions, 3) built-in eval harness for PRs. Use-case: new external maintainer gets repo-ready in <30m.

samir: Nice. Is there any breaking change for existing contribs? Compatibility with existing CI configs?

julia: No breaking changes: all scripts are opt-in. CI adapters support GitHub Actions and Buildkite.

translator-ops: We want to add i18n for CONTRIBUTING.md — can we export strings? I'll open a PR.

maya: Please do. We're aiming for i18n in v0.2. Thanks!

oliver: Quick prod note: added `maintainer:sprint` label to repo for community events.

chris: Office hours this Friday 10am PT to walk folks through onboarding — calendar invite incoming :calendar: 

maya: Thanks everyone! please add any post-launch follow-ups to the "maintainers-springboard" project board.

releasenotes-bot: changelog generated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/maintainers-springboard/CHANGELOG.md

maya: Closing the thread, will pin release in #announcements. :tada:
